items.name: ramen-bowl
items.text: a steaming tonkotsu ramen bowl, cloudy broth beaded with fat, chashu fanned in petals, soft egg halved to a jammy amber yolk, nori standing crisp

items.name: neapolitan-pizza
items.text: a wood-fired Neapolitan pizza, leopard-spotted cornicione, mozzarella still bubbling, basil wilting into the sauce shine

items.name: sushi-selection
items.text: an omakase sushi selection on a hinoki board, tuna glowing ruby, salmon fat-striped, every rice grain distinct under a brush of glaze

items.name: seared-steak
items.text: a crusted ribeye sliced to a rosy edge-to-edge center, mahogany sear glistening, herb butter melting into the board juices

items.name: layer-cake
items.text: a towering layer cake, one slice pulled to expose perfect strata, ganache drips arrested down the sides, crumb tight and moist

items.name: croissants
items.text: shattering-crisp croissants in deep amber egg-wash gloss, one torn open to a honeycomb of lamination, flakes scattered where it broke

items.name: paella-pan
items.text: a saffron paella pan crowded with shellfish, mussels agape, socarrat crackling toffee-dark at the rim

items.name: pho
items.text: a fragrant pho bowl, clear beef broth, herbs stacked high, steam curling past a squeezed lime wedge and floating chilies

items.name: cheeseburger-stack
items.text: a tall smashburger stack, lacy-edged patties, molten cheese cascading past the crust, brioche bun glossed and seeded

items.name: tasting-plate
items.text: a fine-dining tasting plate, three precise elements and one confident sauce swipe, micro herbs set with tweezers, acres of white rim

items.name: dumpling-basket
items.text: a bamboo steamer of pleated dumplings, wrappers turned translucent at the folds, steam breathing through the slats

items.name: pancake-stack
items.text: a pancake stack, syrup caught mid-pour lensing light down each layer, a butter pat sliding on its own melt

items.name: chocolate-fondant
items.text: a chocolate fondant broken open, molten center escaping in a slow glossy flood from the cracked dome, cocoa dust settling

items.name: mezze-spread
items.text: a generous mezze spread from overhead, handmade ceramics, olive-oil pools catching light, sumac dust and torn charred flatbread

items.name: oyster-platter
items.text: freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice, liquor trembling in mother-of-pearl shells, lemon halves and mignonette in a tiny jug

items.name: shakshuka-skillet
items.text: a cast-iron shakshuka, yolks set to a tremble in scarlet pepper sauce, crumbled feta and torn herbs, charred bread standing by

items.name: bento-box
items.text: a lacquered bento box packed in tidy compartments, pressed rice, tamagoyaki sliced into golden layers, one pickled plum centered on white

items.name: tacos-al-pastor
items.text: tacos al pastor on charred corn tortillas, meat shaved straight from the spit, caramelized pineapple, cilantro and white-onion confetti

items.name: seafood-tower
items.text: a tiered seafood tower on shaved ice, split lobster, cracked crab legs, shrimp hooked over the silver rims

items.name: sourdough-loaf
items.text: a torn sourdough boule, blistered crust crackling, open glossy crumb still steaming from the oven

items.name: roast-chicken
items.text: a whole roast chicken burnished mahogany, skin crackled and lacquered with pan juices, thyme charred at the edges, steam escaping the first carving cut

items.name: pasta-twirl
items.text: a fork twirl of tagliatelle lifted off the plate, slow-cooked ragù clinging in the ribbon folds, parmesan snow mid-fall, one strand escaping the coil

items.name: curry-and-naan
items.text: a copper karahi of butter chicken glowing brick-orange, swirled cream split by a chili-oil slick, blistered naan torn and caught mid-dip

items.name: charcuterie-board
items.text: a charcuterie board arranged in rivers, prosciutto folded into loose ribbons, fat-marbled salami coins, cornichons and a split fig, honey pooling against a wedge of blue cheese

items.name: dessert-plated
items.text: a plated dessert built in layers, a quenelle set against a smear of coulis, tempered chocolate standing at an angle
items.text_short: layered plated dessert with a chocolate shard

items.name: breakfast-spread
items.text: a full breakfast spread across a table, eggs and grilled tomato, toast racked upright and coffee going out in steam
items.text_short: full breakfast spread with coffee steaming

items.name: ceviche-peruvian
items.text: Peruvian ceviche in a cold bowl, fish cured white in lime with red onion, corn and sweet potato set alongside
items.text_short: Peruvian ceviche cured white in lime

items.name: jerk-caribbean
items.text: Caribbean jerk chicken off the drum, skin blackened with allspice and scotch bonnet, rice and peas banked beside it
items.text_short: Caribbean jerk chicken blackened with allspice

items.name: gumbo-cajun
items.text: a Cajun gumbo built on a dark roux, okra and andouille through it, rice mounded in the centre of the bowl
items.text_short: Cajun gumbo on a dark roux

items.name: persian-stew
items.text: a Persian herb stew deep green with fenugreek and dried lime, saffron rice with a golden tahdig crust broken open beside it
items.text_short: Persian herb stew with saffron tahdig
